name: 🎮 Fun Games
description: Exciting action games - Snake, Memory Match, Catch & more!

modules.title: 🐍 Snake Game
modules.description: Classic snake game! Eat apples 🍎 to grow longer. Don't hit walls or yourself!

modules.title: 🧠 Memory Match
modules.description: Find matching pairs! Click cards to flip them.

modules.title: 🎯 Catch the Apples
modules.description: Move the basket ⬅️➡️ to catch falling apples 🍎. Avoid bombs 💣!

modules.title: 🎈 Balloon Pop
modules.description: Pop as many balloons as you can! Click fast!

modules.title: 🦘 Number Jump
modules.description: Jump on the correct numbers! Use Space to jump.

modules.title: 🌈 Color Match Speed
modules.description: Click the color that matches the word. Be fast!

modules.title: 🏃 Maze Runner
modules.description: Navigate through the maze to reach the star ⭐

modules.title: 💥 Bubble Blast
modules.description: Pop bubbles of the same color in groups!

modules.title: ⚡ Snap!
modules.description: Click SNAP when two cards match! Quick reflexes game.
